notes.title: Montabi Devlog Update - September 2025
notes.notes: [p][b]Hi Trainers and Montabi friends,[/b][/p][p]I hope you’re all doing really well. Once again, thank you for following us, and special thanks to those of you who joined our playtest last month.[/p][p]In August we focused on adding early drafts for all planned Montabi in the game. In the demo there are 9 species lines of Montabi that players can try, including their evolutions. Now we have added early drafts of 13 new species lines, with evolutions included, making a total of [b]39 new Montabi[/b].[/p][h3]Early Iteration of New Montabi[/h3][p]Disclaimer: all of this new content is still in an iteration stage. We are currently using placeholder illustrations and icons. The main goal is to test playstyles and validate them with the community. Speaking of validation, we held another community playtest session after gaining a lot of insights during the one at the end of July. So once again, if you're interested in trying out content in development, [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2F3krhPAw6zu"][b]join our Discord[/b][/url] and stay tuned for the next playtest opportunities.[/p][p]Compared to the last playtest build, this version allows players to try more content:[/p][h3][b]What’s New in This Version:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Starter charm for the trainer[/p][/*][*][p]3 New Elite Bosses[/p][list][*][p]El Puncho[/p][/*][*][p]Frostmark[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45568276/4da9a38a5e26ddee8a19755912e78159b53272d8.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Spikekrieg[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45568276/a5d5339a1b002cb48a6f43e76a2167304a25c514.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]13 new Montabi species (with evolutions)[/p][list][*][p]Pylo, Cone Montabi[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45568276/a20edeb9a90ef09590395e8f2eba8055a0c30eb7.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Yi Pao, Panda Montabi[/p][/*][*][p]Kaibug, Beast Bug Montabi[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45568276/ac7bec9714f256ec9579082bfa2d95390d23baae.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]T-1LO, Traffic Light Montabi[/p][/*][*][p]Vem, Vending Machine Montabi[/p][/*][*][p]Cressie, Croissant Bee Montabi[/p][/*][*][p]Blizblaze, Lighter Fire Montabi[/p][/*][*][p]Kyuchi, Samurai Dog Montabi[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45568276/639261c80e75d2ae153abb05adf64088e1b564ee.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Tygo, Boxing Tiger Montabi[/p][/*][*][p]Chottle, Turtle Tree Montabi[/p][/*][*][p]Flamble, Firewood Montabi[/p][/*][*][p]Cacto, Cactus Knight Montabi[/p][/*][*][p]Karabi, Spicy Ramen Montabi[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]That brings the current total to 22 species lines of Montabi, with 66 Montabi in total including evolutions. Each Montabi above has its own primary playstyle, and many of them can be combined for fun mix-and-match strategies and synergies.[/p][h3][b]What’s Next:[/b][/h3][p]As mentioned in the previous devlog, our main focus is still on implementing Montabi, iterating, and making them fun to play. This August playtest helps us collect valuable feedback and opinions about the new Montabi. Once again, this was a closed playtest, but you can join our playtester group on Discord.[/p][p]We will also be focusing on adjusting and adding new content to support these Montabi:[/p][list][*][p]Adjustments to existing charms and equipment[/p][list][*][p]New charms[/p][/*][*][p]New equipment[/p][/*][*][p]New supplies[/p][/*][*][p]Additional Elites and Bosses[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]Thank you so much for all your support! Come hang out with us on Discord, share Montabi with your friends, and if you enjoyed the demo, don’t forget to hit that wishlist button. See you next month![/p]

notes.title: Montabi Devlog Update - August 2025
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hey Trainers,[/b][/p][p]We want to share our devlog updates each month, and hopefully provide better insights into what we're working on. [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3141630/view/528724684296946652"]After Monthly Devlog Update, Post Demo – July 2025[/url] Last July, we held a [b]community playtest[/b] from [b]July 18 to 25[/b], where around [b]20 to 30 amazing community members[/b] helped us test changes and improvements made after the demo. Here's the changelog for our latest playtest build:[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]What’s New in This Playtest Version:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]New camera layout[/p][/*][*][p]Updated core loop and drafting system[/p][/*][*][p]Improved UX with double-click interactions[/p][/*][*][p]Faster animations and VFX[/p][/*][*][p]New equipment system[/p][/*][*][p]Evolution 3 is now available, with passive skills[/p][/*][*][p]Glimpses of Areas 2 and 3, with polished transitions[/p][/*][*][p]New room features:[/p][list][*][p][b]Cafe[/b]: Refresh your deck by removing one card[/p][/*][*][p][b]Convenience Store[/b]: Now offers supplies and equipment[/p][/*][*][p][b]Vending Machine[/b]: Now grants equipment[/p][/*][*][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45568276/8df454c3b3a69f02b4ea207a766fd308576827a1.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Gotcharm (new room)[/b]: Obtain Charms here[/p][/*][*][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45568276/222f0720240d42873150560088ee143bd8327581.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New boss: [b]Mr. Alchevine[/b][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Thanks to all our community playtesters. We received tons of feedback through the Google form and discussions on Discord, helping us understand whether these changes are moving in the right direction. Based on that feedback:[/p][list][*][p]The new camera layout works well[/p][/*][*][p]Equipment features improve synergy builds, though some have requested a way to sell unused equipment[/p][/*][*][p]Evolution 3 passive skills are solid, enabling diverse playstyles and making the third evolution feel more rewarding[/p][/*][*][p]Room adjustments are generally well received:[/p][list][*][p][b]Cafe[/b]: Refresh your deck by removing one card[/p][/*][*][p][b]Convenience Store[/b]: Supplies and equipment now available[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]We also received several notes to consider:[/p][list][*][p]A selling feature for unused equipment is under consideration[/p][/*][*][p]Difficulty levels are being planned. We aim to introduce easy, medium, and hard options to improve accessibility for newcomers and provide a solid challenge for roguelike deckbuilder veterans. This will be revisited in the future[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]What’s Next:[/b][/h3][p]We’ll be breaking down the feedback from this playtest and building an action plan. At the same time, we're focusing on improving several key aspects of Montabi:[/p][h3][b]1. Trainer Uniqueness[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Each trainer will have a [b]unique starting Charm[/b][/p][/*][*][p]We're exploring a [b]Rank Up[/b] system to make each trainer more relevant and distinct[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]2. Taming Iteration[/b][/h3][list][*][p]We noticed a common meta where players focus on 1 or 2 Montabi early, then tame stronger ones later[/p][/*][*][p]To balance this, we're testing a system where [b]newly tamed Montabi start at level 1[/b], but receive [b]bonus EXP[/b] to catch up quickly[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]3. Content Pipeline[/b][/h3][list][*][p]August and September will focus on designing and implementing [b]Montabi 21 to 23[/b], completing the full lineup[/p][/*][*][p]This phase will require a [b]lot of iteration and testing[/b], so we’ll host more [b]small community playtest sessions[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Here's a sneak peek at upcoming Montabi that we are iterate:[/p][list][*][p][b]Flambee[/b]: [i]Burn playstyle, apply Burn to yourself to deal more damage. A high-risk, high-reward strategy[/i][/p][/*][*][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45568276/a6b73dedfc949d29671a42484e8872555fcfeaaf.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Karabi:[/b] [i]Spicy playstyle: stack Spicy and deal damage to adjacent enemies at the end of the turn.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45568276/293ab4762f3f6037a94cd33ec5e4e4aa9ff4ecd6.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][/*][/list][p]If you're interested in trying out content in development, [b][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2F3krhPAw6zu"]join our Discord[/url][/b] and stay tuned for the next playtest opportunities.[/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you for being part of this journey.
We truly couldn't do it without you![/p][p][b]Boy "Bochi" Dozan 🐾[/b][/p]

notes.title: Montabi Post Demo Update - July 2025
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hey Trainers,[/b][/p][p]It’s been nearly a month since we released the first [b]Montabi demo[/b] (June 3rd), and we wanted to take a moment to share some insights and updates with you all.[/p][h3]💛 First of all, Thank you![/h3][p]From the bottom of our hearts, thank you to everyone who supported us by wishlisting, playing the demo, sending feedback, and joining our Discord community. It truly means a lot to our small team.[/p][p]Since launch, we’ve released [b]two hotfixes (v0.1.1 and v0.1.2)[/b] to address major bugs reported by players, thank you so much for helping us improve the game![/p][hr][/hr][h3]📊 Demo by the Numbers[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45568276/6a3f9dd071d657ad1be386b39d89c2bc036d8301.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]1,800+ players[/b] played the demo[/p][/*][*][p][b]33 positive reviews[/b] out of 34 on Steam[/p][/*][*][p][b]41 responses[/b] on our feedback form[/p][/*][*][p][b]8.1/10 average fun rating[/b][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]📝 What We Learned from Your Feedback[/h3][p]Here are some of the key issues you raised, and what we’ve done so far to address them:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45568276/10bbfb8ab57660568750edb68dfb5fc4c7d62842.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Double-click UX was frustrating[/b]
→ We’ve simplified most confirmations and replaced double-clicking with single-button actions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tutorial and intro text were too long[/b]
→ We’re redesigning these sections for the full game later to be more concise but still clear.[/p][/*][*][p][b]No way to remove cards[/b]
→ You can now remove cards via a new Café mechanic called [b]Refreshment[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Game pace felt slow[/b]
→ We’ve sped up attack animations, made taming and result scenes faster, and added the ability to skip evolution sequences.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Area 1 Boss countered movement-based strategies too heavily[/b]
→ We’re re-evaluating [b]Scorchpunk’s[/b] placement and may remove him from Area 1.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Difficulty was inconsistent[/b]
→ We’re considering multiple difficulty levels for better accessibility, an easier option for newcomers and a harder one for deckbuilding veterans.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🔧 What We’re Focusing on Next[/h3][p]Now that we’ve completed two hotfixes and addressed core feedback, we’re shifting our focus toward expanding content into [b]Area 2 and Area 3[/b]. As we scale, a few challenges have emerged:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45568276/d80e5adc12087891ddf2625b7fb605708cf077c3.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45568276/d2ef5f5cafde537f92dbac0cb3513f64be1ea509.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Battlefield feels cramped with fully evolved Montabi[/b]
→ We’re prototyping larger grid layouts and camera zoom adjustments.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45568276/cca65d46c6e4e799f852c51d18454ec42a4b9316.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Montabi skill pools may not scale well across full runs[/b]
→ Currently, each Montabi has 12 skills across 3 evolution stages. With longer runs and more Montabi, this risks repetition.
→ We're exploring a new system where each Montabi has 2 “tags” (like elemental types), and pulls skills from both tag pools and a unique skill pool. So each Montabi will have x unique deck pool + x tag A deck pool + x tag B deck pool. This could create deeper synergy and variety, though we’re still prototyping and testing the trade-offs.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Too many draft choices[/b]
→ With 6 units and multiple drafts per level, the current system can lead to [b]48 drafts per run[/b], which is overwhelming.
→ We’re testing a system where you choose one Montabi to level up after each battle instead of gaining EXP across the team, requiring more meaningful decisions. Draft frequency is also being reduced.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Runs are too long (avg. 180 minutes++)[/b]
→ We're working to shorten battle duration and reduce the number of battles per run to aim closer to the 60–90 minute standard.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]⚙️ New Feature: Equipment System[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45568276/99e6280e4a2a0b1e0643f15d5c8f1459e2dc890c.png"][/img][/p][p]We’re also introducing a new feature: [b]Equipment![/b]
Think of it like held items (similar to berries in Pokémon). Each Montabi can hold one item to further customize their build and add new layers of synergy. Early tests are showing promising results![/p][hr][/hr][h3]💬 What’s Next?[/h3][p]We’re planning a [b]small closed playtest next month[/b] to validate some of these new systems. If you're interested in trying out early iterations and giving us feedback, please [url="https://discord.gg/3krhPAw6zu"]join our Discord[/url]![/p][p]Also, we’re planning to post [b]smaller dev updates in Discord[/b] in addition to major devlogs like this one on Steam, so stay tuned and help us shape Montabi together.[/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you for being part of this journey. We truly couldn’t do it without you!
[/p][p]Boy "Bochi" Dozan🐾[/p]

notes.title: Demo Hotfix 0.1.2
notes.notes:

[/p]
